shared_elements: low-relief carving with incised linear detail
repeated decorative elements in a row
justification: A depicts a figural scene — standing human figures facing a table of offerings under a canopy, with additional figures and lines of signs below — while B depicts purely ornamental bands: a row of multi-petalled rosettes above a frieze of stylized palmettes/lotus and a lower arcade of hatched knot-like motifs. The only correspondence is the generic use of shallow relief with incised detail organized into horizontal registers, with no shared creature, object or motif.
